# Documentation Overview

This directory contains comprehensive documentation for the fuzzy-goggles CH32V firmware project.

## 📚 Documentation Structure

### Primary Documentation
- **[README.md](../README.md)** - Main project documentation with quick start guide
- **[CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)** - Development workflow and contribution guidelines  
- **[CHANGELOG.md](../CHANGELOG.md)** - Version history and release notes
- **[src/README.md](../src/README.md)** - Source code organization and component details

### Specialized Documentation
- **[copilot-instructions.md](copilot-instructions.md)** - GitHub Copilot development guidance
- **[Hardware Guide PDF](../BMCU%20370%20Firmware%20Downloading%20Guide.pdf)** - Hardware setup and programming

## 🎯 Document Purpose Guide

### For New Users
Start with **README.md** for:
- Project overview and features
- Quick start instructions
- Hardware requirements
- Basic usage examples

### For Developers  
Review **CONTRIBUTING.md** for:
- Development environment setup
- Build process and testing
- Code guidelines and standards
- Pull request workflow

### For Code Understanding
Check **src/README.md** for:
- Source code architecture
- Component descriptions
- Hardware interfaces
- Development notes

### For AI Assistants
Reference **copilot-instructions.md** for:
- Complete build procedures
- Platform-specific requirements
- Troubleshooting guides
- Validation processes

## 🔧 Documentation Maintenance

### Keeping Documentation Current
- Update README.md when adding major features
- Add entries to CHANGELOG.md for each release
- Update CONTRIBUTING.md when changing development workflow
- Revise copilot-instructions.md when build process changes

### Documentation Standards
- Use clear, concise language
- Include code examples where helpful
- Provide step-by-step instructions
- Maintain consistent formatting
- Update version-specific information promptly
